title: デビュー戦の後に・風のはじまり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr runs wonderfully. She seems convinced that by running in the Twinkle Series, she can realize her dream of becoming the wind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We return to the academy and discuss our future plans. She wants to follow in the Mile Emperor's footsteps by running in the mile tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I agree that we can focus on mile races, I suggest that we also enter sprints to further improve her speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, we need to build up her physique. The two of us decide that our next goal will be the New Zealand Trophy, a graded race in spring.
